description: Source code implementing AES-CTR-HMAC-SHA256 AEAD cipher functions for OpenSSL, including initialization, encryption, decryption, and HMAC calculation.

methods.name: hmac_init
methods.description: Initializes inner and outer SHA256 contexts for HMAC with a given key.

methods.name: aead_aes_ctr_hmac_sha256_init
methods.description: Initializes the AEAD context with a key, setting up encryption and HMAC parameters.

methods.name: aead_aes_ctr_hmac_sha256_cleanup
methods.description: Cleanup function for AEAD context (empty implementation).

methods.name: hmac_update_uint64
methods.description: Updates SHA256 context with a 64-bit integer in little-endian order.

methods.name: hmac_calculate
methods.description: Calculates HMAC over associated data, nonce, and ciphertext.

methods.name: aead_aes_ctr_hmac_sha256_crypt
methods.description: Performs AES-CTR encryption/decryption with a given nonce.

methods.name: aead_aes_ctr_hmac_sha256_seal_scatter
methods.description: Encrypts data and computes HMAC tag for sealing.

methods.name: aead_aes_ctr_hmac_sha256_open_gather
methods.description: Verifies HMAC tag and decrypts data.

methods.name: EVP_aead_aes_128_ctr_hmac_sha256
methods.description: Returns pointer to the 128-bit key AEAD cipher structure.

methods.name: EVP_aead_aes_256_ctr_hmac_sha256
methods.description: Returns pointer to the 256-bit key AEAD cipher structure.
